hooks.command: $d = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd() | ConvertFrom-Json; $t = $d.tool_name; $i = $d.tool_input; $det = ''; if ($i.query) { $det = $i.query } elseif ($i.command) { $det = $i.command } elseif ($i.file_path) { $det = (Split-Path -Leaf $i.file_path) } elseif ($i.url) { $det = $i.url } elseif ($i.pattern) { $det = $i.pattern }; if ($det.Length -gt 70) { $det = $det.Substring(0,70) + '...' }; ConvertTo-Json @{systemMessage="▶ [$t] $det"} -Compress
ConvertTo-Json @{systemMessage="✅ コマンド実行完了"} -Compress
